name: Ryūzōji Koma
source: President of the Cat Lovers Association. A blind catgirl who is several hundered years old. Kagami Mao reminds her of her former master. Uses several Armstrong cannons to hold the boys' dorm hostage in order to get Mao to play Mahjong with her.
